source_packet.selected_slice: For classified licensed firms filing STRs after the STREAMS 2 launch: required reporting channel, permitted submission formats and footnote 3 e-Cert requirement. Retain blackout urgent-contact exception and separate resubmission obligation; do not silently generalize the channel rule into the blackout.

units.text: 1 STREAMS 2 was introduced by the JFIU during the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Webinar held on 17 and 18 November 2025. The presentation material is accessible on the SFC website

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.
